name: felidar_retreat_counters_and_vigilance_this_turn
note: Felidar Retreat: 'Landfall -- Whenever a land you control enters, choose one -- ... Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.' P0 plays a Plains and chooses the second mode: each of P0's two creatures gets one +1/+1 counter, the opponent's creature none, and no Cat Beast is created. P0's Bear then attacks and, having vigilance, stays untapped; it deals 3.
